text: i am extremely confused by what that even means. i never asked for it so politely can u remove it, since i dont think resetting it is what we want to have as a capability at all. maybe im entirely wrong but i dont know what in my flow would need it the way u just explained it
resolution: Removed the 'Reset UV' button from the UV panel per the user (they never asked for it and resetting the UV mapping is not a step in their authoring flow). Removed both Pressable instances from UVPanel.tsx (the header button and the no-faces fallback), dropped the now-unused fullFaceUV and Pressable imports, simplified the no-faces branch back to a plain message Box, and updated the file header comment. The panel is now a pure read-only view of the stored UVs. fullFaceUV remains in editMesh.ts (it is the default UV applied at cuboid()/cylinder() mint, still tested) — only the button is gone. UVPanel.tsx and the full sources.ts chain bundle clean. Updated PLAYBOOK build log + project_studio_mesh_editor memory. Hot-reloadable.
